summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by trivago N.V., a foreign private issuer, reporting voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on June 26, 2026. The AGM covered routine governance items: adoption of annual accounts, appointment of auditor, release from liability, re-appointment of managing and supervisory directors, approval of an incentive plan amendment, and authorizations for share acquisition and cancellation. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign is involved. This is a standard current report of a routine shareholder meeting; thus it does not qualify as a special situation.
